description: Hyperion es un equipo de apasionados por la ciencia, la tecnología y la exploración. Inspirados por nuestro lema, “Per hops, ad astra” (a un salto de las estrellas), creemos que los grandes descubrimientos nacen de superar grandes desafíos. En el NASA Space Apps Challenge combinamos creatividad, trabajo en equipo y nuestros conocimientos para convertir problemas complejos en soluciones con impacto real.
summary: Hestia is a dual-component space healthcare ecosystem linked to a centralized database. First, an interactive chatbot with a dual persona empathetically collects an astronaut’s symptoms without diagnosing, and compiles a technical 30-day clinical report. This report is sent directly to an Earth-based doctor via a Telegram Bot. The doctor replies through Telegram with a treatment plan, which Hestia then displays to the astronaut. To receive medication, the astronaut must use a physical dispensing station equipped with a biometric sensor pad (oximeter, BPM, thermometer) and enter a 4-digit PIN. This strictly enforces a Patient-Hestia-Doctor-Hestia-Patient loop, eliminating self-medication risks. Second, a 24/7 ambient vision AI utilizes the spacecraft’s cameras to continuously evaluate crew routines (sleep, meals, exercise). This behavioral data is added to the user's database, proactively monitoring both physical health and psychological stability during extreme isolation.
details:
What It Does and How It Works Hestia operates as a single, comprehensive software ecosystem driven by a centralized SQLite health database. It works through two main systems:

  1. Telemedicine & Telegram Communication Loop: Hestia maintains a dual persona. When interacting with an astronaut, the chatbot is calm, empathetic, and clear, guiding them without ever inventing diagnoses or authorizing medication independently. Hestia then shifts to a highly technical persona for the Earth-based doctor, compiling the patient's reported symptoms alongside their verified 30-day biometric history. This clinical report is sent directly to the doctor’s mobile device via a Telegram Bot. The doctor reviews the data and replies via Telegram with a diagnosis and treatment plan. Hestia receives this and displays it on the astronaut’s "Treatment" dashboard. To access the prescribed medication, the astronaut must use a physical dispensing station, placing their arm on a sensor suite (oximeter, BPM, thermometer) and entering a custom 4-digit PIN.
  2. Ambient Vision AI: Operating 24/7, a background AI analyzes the spacecraft’s camera feeds to evaluate crew routines. It tracks medication adherence, sleep schedules, food intake, and exercise, adding these behavioral insights to the astronaut's personal database.

Benefits and Intended Impact Hestia completely eliminates the risks associated with in-space pharmacy management. The strict Patient-Hestia-Doctor-Hestia-Patient loop ensures no medication is ever dispensed without human medical authorization and biometric verification, preventing overdoses and self-medication. Additionally, the ambient AI objectively monitors routine disruptions (like skipped meals or irregular sleep), providing critical early warnings regarding a crew member's mental and emotional stability during extreme isolation.

Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware, and Software

  • Software & AI: Python and Node.js for backend logic, SQLite for the centralized database, OpenAI Codex for the symptom-listening chatbot, and the Telegram Bot Platform API for asynchronous doctor-patient communication.
  • Hardware Integration: Arduino IDE, ESP32, and Web Serial APIs bridge the physical biometric sensor pad (oximeter, thermometer, BPM) and 4-digit PIN numpad to the web dashboard.
  • Design: Figma for prototyping the interactive dashboard.

Creativity and Factors Considered Hestia is creative because of its adaptive AI persona—empathetic to the isolated astronaut, yet strictly clinical for the doctor. We considered the severe danger of an open medical kit in microgravity and the communication delays of deep space. By integrating Telegram for direct, lightweight doctor communication, and a hardware-locked biometric dispenser, Hestia creates a highly secure, human-in-the-loop medical safety net that is fully automated on the spacecraft side.
